customSections.title: Gunn Intramuscular Stimulation (IMS / Dry Needling)
bullets: Targets deep spinal and buttock muscles unreachable by hand
Resets hyperactive nerve pathways for lasting pain relief
Highly effective for chronic sciatica, neck pain, and headaches
customSections.content: When nerve roots are sensitized or compressed, deep postural muscles develop permanent taut bands (neuropathic shortening) that stay tight no matter how much you stretch. Gunn IMS uses ultra-fine needles to release these deep contracted muscle fibers, allowing the nerve to heal and eliminating radiating pain.

customSections.subtitle: Relieve deep, chronic muscle spasms that stretching cannot reach.

title: Shockwave Therapy
shortDescription: State-of-the-art, non-invasive treatment that accelerates healing by targeting the root cause of persistent pain.
description: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT) delivers acoustic soundwaves deep into injured tendons and soft tissues, stimulating blood vessel formation, breaking down calcifications, and reactivating the body's natural cellular repair cycle.
benefits: Non-surgical, non-invasive treatment for chronic tendon conditions
Breaks down stubborn calcium deposits and scar tissue
Stimulates collagen synthesis and new blood vessel growth
Significantly reduces pain in 3 to 5 targeted sessions
symptoms: Chronic plantar fasciitis and morning heel pain
Achilles tendonitis and jumper's knee (patellar tendinopathy)
Calcific tendonitis of the rotator cuff in the shoulder
Tennis elbow (lateral epicondylitis) and golfer's elbow
treatmentApproach: Precise anatomical localization of injured tendon fibers
Application of acoustic shockwave pulses tailored to your comfort level
Integration with eccentric strengthening and loading exercises
Progressive rehabilitation protocol over 4–6 weeks

customSections.title: How Acoustic Shockwaves Dissolve Chronic Calcifications
bullets: Non-invasive alternative to cortisone shots or surgery
Typically requires only 3 to 5 weekly sessions of 10–15 minutes
High clinical success rate for chronic plantar fasciitis and tennis elbow
customSections.content: Radial shockwave therapy generates high-energy acoustic pulses that pass through skin into deep tendon structures. These soundwaves trigger 'neovascularization' — the formation of new micro-capillaries that flood scarred, stagnant tendon tissue with oxygen and healing nutrients, while simultaneously breaking apart painful calcifications.
customSections.imageAlt: Acoustic Radial Shockwave Therapy at Nose Creek
customSections.subtitle: Reactivating your body's natural cellular healing cycle without surgery.
